Interview with Nellie Lutcher by Patricia Willard
Reel 4

PRO-TYPISTS, INC.
PROFESSIONAL TRANSCRIPTION SERVICE
AREA CODE 202 347-5395
P R O C E E D I N G S

This is February 23rd, and this is Reel Number 4 of the oral history with Nellie Lutcher. The wheels are turning and today your cold seems to be gone, Nellie, because you were suffering with it the last time we talked.
We just reheard it by relistening to part of Reel 3, and I'm glad you're better today.
